::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 26th 1868  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 224
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
A proof of the history of St Louis, I suppose [M. Guizot](people/person_597.qmd)’s has come here, but I do not know the why or wherefore. Is it a mistake?[^1]

[Mrs Valentine](people/person_1437.qmd) ([Mr Warne](people/person_1433.qmd)’s reader) says they do not know anything of having had '[Wooed and Won](organizations/other_202.qmd)' sent in. Perhaps you would kindly ask whoever was your messenger to whom he gave it

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Would you kindly have both the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd) and [Historical Selections](cmy_books/cmybook_71.qmd) sent to [Madame de Witt](people/person_423.qmd)

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: Guizot contributed to Macmillan's [Sunday Library](organizations/other_145.qmd) a volume entitled *Great Christians of France: St. Louis and Calvin* (London: Macmillan 1868).
